title: Repair Charge for Portable Devices and In-Home Items under Northgate Protect
content:
Under Northgate Protect single-item plans, the repair charge is figured differently for some covered items, read from the item category of the covered order line in the customer's Northgate Store and Online Orders records:

- **Computer, tablet or mobile phone outside the tier's in-home service categories:** the flat repair charge for the claim's type scaled by the limit of liability registered on the plan over the portable reference price of $1500.00, that is, the flat repair charge multiplied by the registered limit and divided by $1500.00.
- **Item in the tier's in-home service categories:** the greater of the flat repair charge for the claim's type and the in-home minimum charge of $249.00.
- **Any other item:** the flat repair charge for the claim's type.

The tier's in-home service categories are, on the Standard tiers, major appliances, fitness equipment, furniture and TV and home theater, and on the Accident tiers, TV and home theater.

## Cases, supposing for illustration a flat repair charge of $100.00 for the claim's type

| Covered item | Limit of liability registered on the plan | Repair charge |
|---|---|---|
| Laptop (computers and tablets) | $900.00 | $60.00 (100 multiplied by 900, divided by 1500) |
| Mobile phone | $1,800.00 | $120.00 (100 multiplied by 1,800, divided by 1500) |
| Television, on a tier listing TV and home theater as in-home | Any | $249.00 (the greater of $100.00 and $249.00) |
| Game console | Any | $100.00 |

Where the flat repair charge itself exceeds $249.00, an in-home item takes the flat repair charge.
